claims.claim: Upgrade your sewing and embroidery projects with this Brother SE630 Computerized Sewing and...
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a Brother sewing machine, but the exact model number (SE630) is not readable.
No country-of-origin marking is shown/readable in the provided photos.
Photos only show the machine; no running/motor sound or stitching test is shown.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual are included
claims.evidence: Accessories/parts and manual are not clearly shown in the photos.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: No service history or internal inspection is shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Exact model may not be SE630 (pricing differs by model/features).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model label/plate (showing “SE630” or exact model number) and/or the manual cover with model name.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Brother computerized sewing machine with unknown model.

risks.risk: Not confirmed working: motor, speed control, and computerized functions may be faulty.
risks.proof: A short video of the machine powered on and performing a stitching test (straight stitch + speed change) with the screen/display functioning.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possibly non-working until a stitching test is shown.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (presser feet, bobbins, needles, power cord, manual) reduce value.
risks.proof: A laid-out photo/video showing every included accessory and the manual, with counts (bobbins/needles/feet) and the power cord shown.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming accessories/manual may be incomplete.

risks.risk: Cosmetic/operational wear (scratches, rust, worn gears/belt) not fully visible from the angles shown.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of moving/critical areas: needle area, feed dogs, underside/belt/gear cover (if accessible), and any visible wear points.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst visible condition level based on limited photos (no guarantee of low wear).

risks.risk: Power/voltage mismatch or missing correct adapter could prevent safe operation.
risks.proof: Photo of the power rating label (voltage/Hz) and a photo of the exact power cord/adapter included.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming power setup may be incomplete or require replacement.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the machine’s model label/plate showing the exact model number (e.g., SE630).
Video: power on + screen/display check + at least one stitching test (straight stitch) with speed control.
Photos/video of all included accessories laid out (presser feet, bobbins, needles, power cord/adapter) and the original manual.
Close-up photos of wear-prone areas (needle/foot area, feed dogs, and any accessible underside/belt/gear area).
Photo of the power rating label (voltage/Hz) and confirmation the included cord/adapter matches Lagos power.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies it as a Brother computerized sewing machine, but the exact model and working/accessory status are not verifiable from the photos. I can still price it at the worst-case assumption for an unknown model and unproven completeness/working condition.
